stem: The committee declined to revise the regulation ____ it had received numerous complaints.
explanation: Boşluktan sonra tam cümle (it had received ...) var ve zıtlık anlamı isteniyor. Despite / In spite of isim alır; Even though tam cümle alır.

stem: ____ the unfavourable weather conditions, the expedition reached the summit on schedule.
explanation: Boşluktan sonra isim grubu (the unfavourable weather conditions) geliyor. Zıtlık + isim = Despite.

stem: Some analysts believe the recovery will be rapid, ____ others expect a prolonged slowdown.
explanation: Cümlenin iki yarısı birbirine zıt görüşler içeriyor ve ikinci yarıda tam cümle var: Whereas ('oysa').

stem: The new drug has proven effective in trials; ____, it is not yet available to patients because of licensing delays.
explanation: Noktalı virgülden sonra virgülle ayrılmış, zıtlık bildiren bir zarf gerekiyor: However. Although, noktalı virgülden sonra iki cümleyi bağlayamaz.

stem: Exports of manufactured goods have grown steadily; ____, agricultural exports have fallen sharply.
explanation: İki zıt bilgi (artış – düşüş) karşılaştırılıyor: On the other hand.

stem: ____ most of his colleagues, Dr. Aydın rejected the proposed theory.
explanation: Kişiler arasında zıtlık ve sonrasında isim grubu var: Unlike. Whereas tam cümle gerektirir.

stem: ____ the bridge was structurally unsafe, the authorities closed it to traffic.
explanation: Boşluktan sonra tam cümle ve neden anlamı var. Because of isim alır; Since tam cümle alır.

stem: The flight was cancelled ____ the dense fog that covered the entire region.
explanation: Boşluktan sonra isim grubu (the dense fog ...) var: Owing to. Because ve although tam cümle ister.

stem: ____ the funding has finally been approved, the researchers can begin the second phase.
explanation: Gerçekleşmiş bir durumdan yola çıkarak sonuç bildiriliyor: Now that ('madem ki').

stem: The factory failed to meet safety standards; ____, it was ordered to suspend production.
explanation: İkinci cümle birincinin sonucunu bildiriyor: Consequently.

stem: The instructions were ____ ambiguous that most participants misinterpreted them.
explanation: 'ambiguous' sıfatı tek başına duruyor ve 'that' ile sonuç cümlesi geliyor: so ... that.

stem: It was ____ a challenging task that only a few candidates managed to complete it.
explanation: 'a challenging task' isim grubu olduğu için such + a + sıfat + isim + that kullanılır.

stem: The researchers anonymised the data ____ participants' privacy would be protected.
explanation: Yeni özne (participants' privacy) ve modal (would) var: so that. In order to / so as to sonrasında yalın fiil gelir.

stem: Several countries have imposed stricter regulations ____ reduce carbon emissions.
explanation: Sonrasında yalın fiil (reduce) var ve özne değişmiyor: in order to + V1.

stem: He kept the documents locked in a safe lest they ____ stolen.
explanation: Lest + should + V1 (veya yalın fiil). Lest zaten olumsuz anlam taşır; 'not' kullanılmaz.

stem: Take a spare key with you ____ you lose the first one.
explanation: Önlem anlamı var ve sonrasında tam cümle geliyor: in case. 'In case of' isim alır.

stem: Visitors are permitted to take photographs ____ they do not use a flash.
explanation: 'Sadece flaş kullanmamaları şartıyla' anlamı isteniyor: provided that.

stem: The negotiations will collapse ____ both parties make concessions.
explanation: 'Her iki taraf taviz vermedikçe' anlamı için unless gerekir (unless = if not).

stem: ____ the treatment proves effective, patients will need regular check-ups for several years.
explanation: Henüz kesin olmayan bir olasılık söz konusu ve tam cümle var: Even if.

stem: ____ the government acted earlier, the crisis might have been prevented.
explanation: Ana cümlede might have been prevented (3. tip koşul) var. If'siz devrik yapı: Had + özne + V3.

stem: ____ the volunteers' tireless efforts, the festival could not have taken place.
explanation: Sonrasında isim grubu var ve anlam 'olmasaydı': But for (= if it had not been for).

stem: You must register before the deadline; ____, you will lose your right to apply.
explanation: Önceki cümlede zorunluluk var, ikinci cümle olumsuz sonuç bildiriyor: otherwise.

stem: The new policy will lower administrative costs; ____, it will make the process more transparent.
explanation: İkinci cümle aynı yönde ek bir olumlu bilgi ekliyor: furthermore.

stem: ____ offering free tuition, the university provides accommodation for gifted students.
explanation: Sonrasında V-ing var ve anlam 'ek olarak': In addition to.

stem: Not only ____ the company lose its largest client, but it also had to lay off hundreds of workers.
explanation: Not only cümle başındayken devrik yapı gerekir: Not only did the company lose ...

stem: Both the manager ____ the assistant were present at the meeting.
explanation: Both yalnızca and ile eşleşir.

stem: Neither the director nor the employees ____ aware of the changes.
explanation: Neither ... nor yapısında fiil, nor'a yakın özneye uyar: the employees → were.

stem: ____ the delegates were discussing the proposal, a fire alarm went off.
explanation: Sonrasında tam cümle (past continuous) var ve eş zamanlılık anlatılıyor: While. During isim alır.

stem: As soon as the new system ____ installed, the staff will receive training.
explanation: Zaman bağlaçlarından sonra gelecek için present simple kullanılır: is installed.

stem: The committee did not announce its decision ____ all the evidence had been reviewed.
explanation: 'Not ... until' kalıbı: kanıtlar gözden geçirilene kadar karar açıklanmadı.

stem: By the time the ambulance arrived, the patient ____ consciousness.
explanation: By the time + past simple → ana cümlede past perfect (had lost).

stem: ____ the economy slows down, unemployment tends to rise.
explanation: Genelleme ve tekrar eden durum anlatılıyor: Whenever.

stem: Inflation ____ steadily since the central bank changed its policy last year.
explanation: Since + past simple olduğu için ana cümlede present perfect (continuous) gerekir.

stem: Hardly had the speaker finished ____ the audience burst into applause.
explanation: Hardly / Scarcely ... WHEN; No sooner ... THAN.

stem: ____ launching the product, the company carried out extensive market research.
explanation: Sonrasında V-ing var ve zaman önceliği anlatılıyor: Prior to.

stem: ____ the earthquake, thousands of residents were left homeless.
explanation: Sonrasında isim grubu var ve olayın ardından anlamı isteniyor: Following.

stem: Many historic buildings were damaged ____ the war.
explanation: Sonrasında isim (the war) var: during.

stem: Many students prefer studying at home ____ going to the library.
explanation: Sonrasında V-ing var ve tercih anlamı isteniyor: instead of.

stem: All the applicants ____ one were invited to the interview.
explanation: 'Biri hariç' anlamı için except gerekir.

stem: ____ hard he tried, he could not solve the problem.
explanation: However + sıfat / zarf + özne + fiil: 'Ne kadar uğraşsa da'.

stem: ____ the project succeeds or not, the team will receive a bonus.
explanation: 'İster ... ister' anlamı için whether ... or (not) kullanılır.

stem: She behaves as if she ____ the owner of the company.
explanation: Gerçek dışı karşılaştırmada as if + were (şimdiki zaman).

stem: ____ the latest report, the number of tourists increased by 12 per cent.
explanation: Bir kaynağa dayanarak bilgi veriliyor: According to.

stem: ____ the question of funding, no decision has been made yet.
explanation: Konuyu belirten ifade: With regard to (-e ilişkin).

stem: The first treatment reduced symptoms in most patients; ____, the second proved equally effective.
explanation: İki cümle benzer yönde olduğu için Similarly gerekir.

stem: Several industries, ____ textiles and steel, were severely affected.
explanation: Örnek verirken isim grubundan önce such as kullanılır.

stem: The company aims to be carbon-neutral by 2035; ____, it will eliminate all net emissions within a decade.
explanation: İkinci cümle birincinin yeniden ifadesi: In other words.

stem: ____, the evidence suggests that early intervention is far more cost-effective.
explanation: Metnin genel çıkarımı ve sonucu: In conclusion.

stem: Many assumed the project would fail; ____, it exceeded every expectation.
explanation: Önceki yanlış varsayımı düzeltiyor: In fact.

stem: The engineers repaired the generator. ____, the technicians restored power to the east wing.
explanation: İki olay aynı anda gerçekleşiyor: Meanwhile.

stem: The patients were examined first; ____, they were referred to specialists.
explanation: Olaylar kronolojik sıradadır: Subsequently.
